Blueprints/Minerals/PI tabs are SectionTabs compact (hash sync off, default_tab=initial_tab). The stacked fixed-height panel grid is gone: hidden panels are display:none like every SectionTabPanel. activeTab had no readers.
Topic chips are SectionTabs pills (hash sync off, random id_prefix per instance); a single topic hides the pill row as before.
Same four hrefs; active_tab passed explicitly because /learning/ is a prefix of the other three. The tabs wrap instead of scrolling sideways.
Same hrefs and campaigns gate; active_tab passed explicitly.
Pills variant; the open-asks count is the attention-flagged meta (yellow dot badge instead of the red box).
Fitting tag checkboxes become RadioCheckInput (library box, small yellow label) instead of native checkboxes with white label text.
Cell and header text take the DataTable colours: cells inherit the page yellow instead of white, numeric headers are white instead of yellow.
Numeric columns (the er-table__numeric class had no rule, so they were left-aligned) take DataTable's right alignment with tabular figures.

The checked-label rule was `:checked + small`, which never matched because the box sits between the input and the label text; it is now `:checked ~ small`, so a checked option's label is bold and full-strength white instead of staying yellow, on every RadioCheckInput.
The picker's label is the Combobox label: full-strength white (was the muted manage-field label), 18px line instead of 17px, and a 10px gap to the field instead of 5px, so each picker is 6px taller.
